n0c92eeaeeb.headline: Is it 26% or 27%? Donald Trump’s ‘Liberation Day’ reciprocal tariff on India sparks confusion | Today News
n0c92eeaeeb.summary: A White House annex shows future reciprocal tariff rates differ for at least 14 nations from the charts shown when Trump announced his Liberation Day tariffs, including India.
n0c92eeaeeb.why: Reciprocal tariff rates determine the cost of US imports from trading partners and shape export outlooks for affected economies.

ned7a93604c.headline: SPA leader confirms incoming ban on betting with social welfare in Brazil
ned7a93604c.summary: Regis Dudena, head of Brazil's SPA, confirmed that gambling using social welfare proceeds will be banned in Brazil.
ned7a93604c.why: Brazil's regulated betting market is growing quickly, and rules on gambling operators affect the companies serving it.

n75ed42deb5.headline: JP Morgan seeks merchant banking licence from CBN to bolster African presence
n75ed42deb5.summary: JPMorgan Chase is seeking a merchant banking licence from the Central Bank of Nigeria to convert its Lagos representative office into a fully operational business branch. The move would expand its Nigerian operations.
n75ed42deb5.why: JPMorgan is one of the largest global investment banks, and its African expansion signals growing institutional activity in Nigeria's financial sector.

nfe743925df.headline: Heard Island and McDonald Islands, the uninhabited territory where Trump has imposed tariffs
nfe743925df.summary: A 10% levy has been imposed on exports from Heard Island and McDonald Islands, a remote uninhabited territory near Antarctica. The territory has only birds, penguins and seals.
nfe743925df.why: US tariff actions affect global trade flows, and even small territorial levies can signal the reach of broader trade policy.

n020049f9df.headline: London’s FTSE tumbles after Trump’s tariffs send shockwaves through markets
n020049f9df.summary: The FTSE 100 index fell 122.4 points in the first few minutes of trading as Trump's tariffs sent shockwaves through markets.
n020049f9df.why: The FTSE 100 is the benchmark index of the largest companies listed in London, and it is sensitive to global trade policy because many members earn revenue abroad.

impacts.name: FTSE 100
impacts.why: Tariff announcements raise trade-war fears, prompting selling of globally exposed UK-listed shares.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n020049f9df.why_moved: The index dropped in early trading after US tariff measures were announced, which investors read as a threat to global trade.

n19028f1828.headline: Nigeria's Economy Saves N31.1bn Through Shippers' Council Automated Demurrage Fee Portal
n19028f1828.summary: The Nigerian Shippers' Council said its automated demurrage fee portal saved the federal government N31.1 billion between January and June 2024.
n19028f1828.why: Demurrage charges are fees for delayed container use at ports, and efficient port administration lowers trade costs.

n8427f56204.headline: Trump tariffs on Mexico: the good, the bad, the unknown
n8427f56204.summary: At first glance Mexico got off lightly from Donald Trump's 'Liberation Day' tariff blitz, though the US president has repeatedly threatened further measures against it.
n8427f56204.why: Mexico is one of the largest trading partners of the United States, so tariff policy directly affects its exports, manufacturing and currency.

nf6b0157a36.headline: Need for ‘maturity’ in EU-US talks on tariffs, Harris says
nf6b0157a36.summary: Harris called for maturity in EU-US tariff talks after US President Donald Trump announced a sweeping 20% tariff on imports from the European Union.
nf6b0157a36.why: The European Union is one of the largest trading blocs in the world, and US tariffs on its goods affect exporters and global trade flows.

ncdd6591bed.headline: NCBA & AGF Bolster SME Financing with KES 3 Billion Guarantee Extension : TechMoran
ncdd6591bed.summary: NCBA Bank and African Guarantee Fund signed an enhanced guarantee agreement of KES 3 billion for 10 years. The deal is meant to increase NCBA's lending to Kenya's SME segment.
ncdd6591bed.why: NCBA is a Kenyan bank, and guarantees from development-focused funds reduce lending risk, enabling banks to finance small and medium enterprises.

n5e9f5f6f4c.headline: Saudi Arabia's inbound tourism spending reaches record $41bn
n5e9f5f6f4c.summary: Inbound tourism spending in Saudi Arabia rose to a record SR153.61 billion ($40.95 billion) in 2024. The growth reflects the kingdom's investment in its travel sector.
n5e9f5f6f4c.why: Tourism is a growing non-oil revenue source for Saudi Arabia, which is diversifying its economy under its national development plans.

n75fdbcc310.headline: Trade and Industry Minister takes muted approach to higher tariffs by US against global trade partners
n75fdbcc310.summary: US President Donald Trump announced sweeping 'liberation day' tariffs, including a 10% base tariff on some countries and higher rates for those running trade deficits with the US. South Africa's trade minister has taken a muted approach.
n75fdbcc310.why: US tariff policy affects global trade flows and export-dependent economies, and it is closely watched by investors. South Africa is a major trading economy whose exports can be affected by changes in US trade rules.

n8219694897.headline: EU's tariff response should target Republican-led US states and tech firms, Austria says
n8219694897.summary: Austria says the EU's countermeasures against Trump's universal tariffs should target Republican-led US states and tech firms to force Washington back to the negotiating table.
n8219694897.why: EU retaliation against US tariffs can affect transatlantic trade in goods and services and the earnings of exporters and US technology firms.

nd6d2664547.headline: Pony.ai Europe Secures Luxembourg Robotaxi Testing Permit
nd6d2664547.summary: Pony.ai Europe, the European division of autonomous driving firm Pony.ai, has obtained a scientific testing permit for robotaxi trials in Luxembourg.
nd6d2664547.why: Pony.ai is a Chinese-founded autonomous driving company listed on Nasdaq, and European permits are a step toward commercial robotaxi services.

nd7cbfab32e.headline: 'Take a deep breath': Treasury Secretary urges countries not to retaliate against tariffs
nd7cbfab32e.summary: The Treasury Secretary urged countries not to retaliate as a 10% baseline tariff takes effect Saturday, with reciprocal tariffs set to begin April 9.
nd7cbfab32e.why: The S&P 500 tracks large US companies, which are sensitive to tariff policy affecting trade, input costs and global demand.
nd7cbfab32e.why_moved: A 10% baseline tariff and reciprocal tariffs are scheduled to start, raising the risk of retaliation from trading partners.

nab51aedfcb.headline: The REAL impact 2025 Trump tariffs will have on South Africa
nab51aedfcb.summary: An analysis examines the real impact of the 2025 Trump tariffs on South Africa, the US being its second-largest trading partner. The tariffs followed the so-called Liberation Day announcement.
nab51aedfcb.why: US tariffs on South African exports affect trade volumes, currency flows and sectors that rely on US demand such as autos and agriculture.

n392746364c.headline: Average earnings forecast to climb by 15% by 2030, but not everywhere is seeing positive growth
n392746364c.summary: Average earnings are forecast to climb by 15% by 2030, though some areas are expected to see salary declines. The forecast highlights uneven regional growth.
n392746364c.why: Wage growth affects household spending power, inflation pressure and the Bank of England's policy considerations.

n7438d01a82.headline: IMF visit begins Friday to assist with Pakistan’s 2025–26 budget
n7438d01a82.summary: An IMF visit to Pakistan begins Friday to assist with the 2025-26 budget. Fiscal control and tax strategy are on the agenda.
n7438d01a82.why: The IMF lends to Pakistan under conditions tied to fiscal discipline and tax reform, which shape the country's budget and debt outlook.

n509c722d32.headline: UK pins hopes on US trade talks after Trump tariffs
n509c722d32.summary: Britain has been spared the toughest tariff treatment from President Donald Trump, and London is counting on a trade deal with Washington.
n509c722d32.why: The UK is a major trading partner of the US, so the outcome of tariff talks affects British exporters, sterling and the wider economy.

nbe0585c6b0.headline: Tonbo Imaging raises Rs 175 Cr in Series D funding round
nbe0585c6b0.summary: Tonbo Imaging said the fresh funding will go to product development, including infrared sensors, commercial deployment of microwave technologies and working capital.
nbe0585c6b0.why: Series D is a late-stage private funding round, and such capital shows investor backing for defence and imaging technology companies in India.

n8ecced9cc4.headline: World leaders criticise Trump tariffs as 'major blow'
n8ecced9cc4.summary: European Commission chief Ursula von der Leyen called Trump's decision to impose new tariffs on all goods entering the US a major blow to the world economy. Other world leaders also criticised the move.
n8ecced9cc4.why: Broad US tariffs on imports affect global trade flows, export-dependent economies and cross-border investment.

n0e1928a58e.headline: London’s FTSE tumbles after Trump’s tariffs send shockwaves through markets
n0e1928a58e.summary: The FTSE 100 index fell 122.4 points in the first few minutes of trading after Trump's tariffs sent shockwaves through markets. The sell-off followed the tariff news.
n0e1928a58e.why: The FTSE 100 is the benchmark index of the largest companies listed in London, many of which earn substantial revenue abroad and are exposed to trade policy.

impacts.name: FTSE 100
impacts.why: The index fell over 122 points early in trading as tariff news hit global equities.

n0e1928a58e.why_moved: The article attributes the decline to Trump's tariffs, which shook markets and triggered the early sell-off in London.

nce3dd0f694.headline: U.S. crypto stocks slide as Trump's sweeping tariffs jolt markets
nce3dd0f694.summary: US crypto stocks declined on Thursday after President Donald Trump's latest round of sweeping tariffs rattled investor confidence, sparking a sell-off in riskier assets.
nce3dd0f694.why: Crypto-related equities are shares of companies tied to digital assets, and they tend to be sensitive to shifts in risk appetite.
nce3dd0f694.why_moved: Trump's latest sweeping tariffs raised global trade tensions and hit investor confidence, prompting a sell-off in riskier assets including crypto stocks.

n217ff5cd36.headline: Reciprocal tariffs on US trading partners will have ‘ripple effects’ on Australia
n217ff5cd36.summary: Higher US tariffs on trading partners could eventually affect Australia's new-car market and wider economy. The report points to indirect effects rather than an immediate measure.
n217ff5cd36.why: Australia is an export-oriented economy whose car market depends heavily on imported vehicles, so trade tariffs can feed into prices and demand.

n0e0e709f2a.headline: OECD headline inflation slows slightly to 4.5% in February 2025
n0e0e709f2a.summary: OECD headline inflation slowed slightly to 4.5% in February 2025. The figure covers the grouping of advanced economies tracked by the organisation.
n0e0e709f2a.why: The OECD tracks inflation across its 38 member countries, which informs central bank policy and investor expectations for interest rates.

nc179942a19.headline: Reciprocal tariffs on US trading partners will have ‘ripple effects’ on Australia
nc179942a19.summary: Increased US tariffs on its trading partners could eventually affect Australia's new-car market and wider economy, according to the report.
nc179942a19.why: Australia is a trade-exposed economy, and changes in global tariffs affect import prices, car sales and demand across the wider economy.

n004bfcf2b2.headline: Australian shares narrow early losses after Trump dump
n004bfcf2b2.summary: The Australian share market closed lower but recovered from an early sell-off after worse-than-expected US tariffs spooked investors.
n004bfcf2b2.why: The ASX is Australia's main stock market, and it tends to react to US trade policy given its exposure to global commodity and trade flows.
n004bfcf2b2.why_moved: Worse-than-expected US tariffs spooked investors, driving an early sell-off before shares recovered part of the losses.

nb92f29c568.headline: Reciprocal tariffs on US trading partners will have ‘ripple effects’ on Australia
nb92f29c568.summary: Higher US tariffs on trading partners could eventually affect Australia's new-car market and the wider economy, according to The Courier.
nb92f29c568.why: Australia is an open trading economy, so changes in US trade policy can flow through to exports, consumer demand and interest rate expectations.

n6fbfd204ea.headline: PSU stock Bank of India gains 3% on Q4 business update. Do you own? | Stock Market News
n6fbfd204ea.summary: Bank of India shares rose 3% after it reported 11.95% growth in global business for Q4 FY2025. Global advances grew 13.59%, and domestic advances rose 14.28%.
n6fbfd204ea.why: Bank of India is a state-owned Indian lender, and its quarterly business updates indicate loan and deposit trends in the banking system.

nf70ac2dced.headline: Bank of Baroda shares gain as Q4 business update shows strong growth | Stock Market News
nf70ac2dced.summary: Bank of Baroda shares rose after its Q4 update showed 11.44% year-on-year growth in global business to ₹27.03 trillion. Advances rose 12.88% and deposits rose 10.25%.
nf70ac2dced.why: Bank of Baroda is one of India's large state-owned lenders, so its loan and deposit growth is watched as a read on the banking sector.

ne5342a7a09.headline: Ringgit stable against US dollar, ends marginally higher at 4.44
ne5342a7a09.summary: The ringgit closed relatively stable and marginally higher at 4.44 against the US dollar, after earlier pressure from President Trump's global reciprocal tariff announcements.
ne5342a7a09.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its exchange rate affects import costs, trade competitiveness and foreign investor sentiment. Malaysia is a major Asian trading economy.

n4352e047ec.headline: Germany faces new world trade order amid triple threat from US duties
n4352e047ec.summary: Germany awoke to a transformed global trade order after President Trump announced sweeping customs duties, with the United States set to introduce blanket duties across trading partners.
n4352e047ec.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy and a major exporter of machinery and cars, so changes to US tariffs directly affect its industrial exporters. Trade policy shifts are a key macro risk for European equities.

n37140297c5.headline: S&P 500 sees worst day since 2020 after Trump's sweeping tariff announcement
n37140297c5.summary: US stocks fell sharply after President Trump announced sweeping new tariffs. The drop raised fears of a global recession and prompted international responses.
n37140297c5.why: The S&P 500 tracks about 500 large US companies and is the main barometer of US equity market sentiment. Broad tariff increases can weigh on corporate earnings and global growth expectations.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Index fell sharply on the day after new sweeping tariffs were announced.

n37140297c5.why_moved: Investors reacted to new sweeping US tariffs, which raised fears of a global recession.

n9a2bf38ec7.headline: THL: Government cuts shrink unemployed households' income by 20%
n9a2bf38ec7.summary: According to the Institute for Health and Welfare, the spending power of many low-income benefit recipients has slumped, with unemployed households' income reduced by about 20% due to government cuts.
n9a2bf38ec7.why: Changes to government benefits and spending affect household consumption and the fiscal outlook, which matter for economic growth and policy.

n9fdbe603f3.headline: Trump's tariffs trigger two-week shutdown at Stellantis assembly plant in Windsor
n9fdbe603f3.summary: Stellantis is temporarily pausing production at its Windsor, Ontario assembly plant for two weeks. The automaker is assessing the effects of recently announced US tariffs on imported vehicles.
n9fdbe603f3.why: Stellantis is a global automaker formed from Fiat Chrysler and PSA, with major North American plants. Tariffs on imported vehicles raise costs and can force production changes at cross-border plants.

impacts.name: Stellantis
impacts.why: A two-week production pause at a major assembly plant reduces near-term vehicle output and sales.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n6d22870069.headline: Dabur shares plummet over 7% as Q4 update indicates subdued volume growth
n6d22870069.summary: Dabur India shares dropped more than 7% after the company reported flat consolidated revenue and a decline in operating margin for Q4 FY25. Rural markets showed better growth.
n6d22870069.why: Dabur is a major Indian consumer goods company selling health and personal care products, so its volume growth signals demand in Indian FMCG.
n6d22870069.why_moved: The Q4 update showed flat consolidated revenue and lower operating margin due to inflation and operating deleverage, with subdued volume growth.

nfa11497044.headline: Thailand Turns Used Cooking Oil into Sustainable Aviation Fuel
nfa11497044.summary: A factory is being built near Bangchak's oil refinery in Bangkok's Phra Khanong area to produce sustainable aviation fuel from used cooking oil.
nfa11497044.why: Bangchak is a Thai refiner and fuel distributor, and sustainable aviation fuel is a growing low-carbon alternative to jet fuel.

n11d46f6a3c.headline: Kia and LG Electronics Partner to Showcase New PBV Concepts for Work and Play
n11d46f6a3c.summary: Kia and LG Electronics announced a partnership to collaborate on mobility space solutions based on Kia's purpose-built vehicle (PBV) concepts for work and play.
n11d46f6a3c.why: Kia is a major carmaker and LG Electronics a large electronics maker, so their collaboration signals how automakers and electronics firms are working together on new mobility products.

n7ded90ac5f.headline: Malaysia rules out retaliatory tariffs, explores measures to mitigate export impact
n7ded90ac5f.summary: Malaysia's trade ministry said it will not retaliate against the 10% tariff hike and reciprocal tariffs imposed by the United States. It is instead engaging with US authorities to seek solutions.
n7ded90ac5f.why: Malaysia is a major exporter of electronics and components, so US tariffs directly affect its export sector.

n6ccd82b227.headline: Touhid for result-oriented BIMSTEC FTA
n6ccd82b227.summary: Bangladesh's foreign affairs adviser stressed tangible cooperation and effective implementation of the BIMSTEC Free Trade Area at the 20th BIMSTEC Ministerial Meeting in Bangkok.
n6ccd82b227.why: BIMSTEC is a regional grouping linking South and Southeast Asian economies, and a free trade area would reduce tariffs for intra-regional trade.

nb722c53deb.headline: Here's How Trump's New Reciprocal Tariffs Could Potentially "Destroy" Consumer PC Markets; Prices Might Rise By Up To 50%
nb722c53deb.summary: Trump's new reciprocal tariffs could cause consumer PC hardware prices to rise massively, by up to 50%, according to a Wccftech report.
nb722c53deb.why: Consumer electronics makers and retailers rely on imported components, so tariffs on those parts pass through to end-user prices.

n5f58e449ba.headline: Electricity prices slashed by Rs1.90 per unit under quarterly adjustment
n5f58e449ba.summary: Electricity prices in Pakistan are being reduced by Rs1.90 per unit under a quarterly adjustment, following an announcement by Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif.
n5f58e449ba.why: Electricity tariffs affect household inflation, power utility revenues and the cost base of Pakistan's industrial sector.

nfa525c70f3.headline: Apple Could Suffer Up To A 9 Percent Drop In Gross Margin Because Of Trump’s Tariffs If It Keeps Prices Unchanged; Analyst Highlights Steps To Help Company Minimize Its Losses
nfa525c70f3.summary: An analyst estimates Apple could suffer a gross margin drop of up to 9 percent from Trump tariffs if it keeps prices unchanged. The analysis also outlines steps to minimise losses.
nfa525c70f3.why: Apple is a major consumer electronics maker whose hardware margins depend heavily on global supply chains and import costs.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Tariffs raise the cost of imported components and products, pressuring gross margins if prices are not raised.

n27eca9dc59.headline: Gold prices in Pakistan reach record highs
n27eca9dc59.summary: Gold prices in Pakistan have surged to a new all-time high, according to the All Pakistan Sarafa Jewellers association's reported rates.
n27eca9dc59.why: Gold is a widely used store of value and hedge, and local prices reflect both global bullion and the rupee exchange rate.

nb7fceb0dd6.headline: US stocks, dollar tumble as Trump tariffs fuel economic worries
nb7fceb0dd6.summary: The S&P 500 plunged more than 4% as the dollar weakened and bonds rallied amid global recession fears and the impact of trade tariffs.
nb7fceb0dd6.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US listed companies and is the main benchmark for US equity performance.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The input reports the index plunging more than 4% on tariff-driven recession fears.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nb7fceb0dd6.why_moved: Tariff-driven recession fears prompted a broad sell-off, with investors moving into bonds and away from the dollar and equities.

n8fc3b04e5f.headline: Shoppers weigh impact of Trump's tariffs on grocery imports, prices, and shortages
n8fc3b04e5f.summary: New U.S. tariffs add charges on imports such as produce from about 60 countries. Shoppers may face higher grocery prices and possible shortages.
n8fc3b04e5f.why: Tariffs on food imports raise input costs for retailers and can feed into consumer inflation, affecting grocery chains and food companies.

neeefd8933a.headline: Singh proposes Canada Victory Bonds to bolster the country in face of U.S. tariffs
neeefd8933a.summary: NDP Leader Jagmeet Singh proposed tax-free Victory Bonds to shore up the Canadian economy against tariffs from US President Donald Trump.
neeefd8933a.why: Government bonds are debt securities issued to fund public spending, and proposed bond programs can affect fiscal policy. Tariffs are taxes on imported goods that can weigh on trade-exposed economies.
